label: Slit aperture

blackness.help: fraction of incident power absorbed by the plate (default 1.0: a diffraction SCREEN must be opaque; lower for a real blackened part)

tooltip: Rectangular slit opening in a blackened plate, plus a thin material=air plug filling the opening (the aperture contract, docs/RAYTRACER.md S5.10). 'blackness' drives the plate's absorbance property directly (re-derived every rebuild).
